answer:
13,047 CHIP variants remain after removing reference calls.

The dataset is the 86 supplied files in data/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS (the trio file lists 87 samples; trio ID 533 has no variant file). Each file was read with its two-tier combined header (33 cols). A 'reference call' is a row with Zygosity == 'Reference' (REF/REF, no variant allele); rows with Zygosity NaN (other allele of multi-allelic sites) were kept, per approved assumption A. Sanity checks passed in all 86 files: In_CHIP == True for every row, and all Match gene values fall within the 56-gene Schenz et al. 2022 CHIP list (case-insensitive; e.g. SF3b1→SF3B1, cblB→CBLB). All 86 file sample IDs matched trio IDs after stripping tabs/trailing spaces and '-P*' suffixes.

Results:
- Total variant rows across 86 files: 57,258
- Reference calls removed (Zygosity == 'Reference'): 44,211
- PRIMARY (approved definition B): non-reference rows kept, summed per sample: 13,047
- SECONDARY: unique (Chr:Pos, Ref/Alt) variants among kept rows across the whole dataset: 699

Per-sample kept rows range from 108 (354-PM) to 672 (380-P; files 380-P and 381-PM contain far fewer reference calls than the other files, ~32–34 vs ~500). Full per-sample table is in the evidence output file.
